title: Efficacy and Safety of TJ-100 in the Treatment of Chronic Constipation
brief_summary: TJ-100, a Japanese herbal medicine, is clinically effective in postoperative ileus. So it may activate bowel movement. This study will test the efficacy and safety of TJ-100 in the treatment of patients with chronic constipation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* chronic constipation defined as less than 3 spontaneous bowel movement frequencies per week
* had symptoms of abdominal bloating or discomfort

Exclusion Criteria:

* mechanical bowel obstruction
* clinically systemic disease-induced constipation
* pregnancy
